data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate recorded an underwriting profit before investment income of GBP 3.2m (2021: GBP 6.6m loss), mainly driven by an improvement in underwriting performance on the 2021 YOA which contributed GBP 14.0m to the underwriting result.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2022 the Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at the start of the year was GBP 418.211m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net adverse prior year development of approximately GBP 30.5m (c.7.3% of opening reserves), driven largely by adverse development in the 2020 underwriting year partially offset by favourable movement on older years and an improvement reported on the 2021 year of account. Key drivers noted in the report include exposures to Hurricane Ian and claims related to the war in Ukraine (many of which are currently held in IBNR), plus impacts from large claims and reinsurance / RITC movements that could distort development patterns.
raw_causal_phrases: During 2022 we saw an increase of claims incurred due to the impact of the war in Ukraine across all underwriting years. This is current held primarily in IBNR. Other losses for which the Syndicate had large exposure during the year were Hurricane Ian.
improvement in underwriting performance on the 2021 YOA which contributed GBP 14.0m to the underwriting result.
recovery of the 2019 Year of Account ("YOA") loss from capital providers during the distribution process.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (GBP 30.511m) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross values) on page 45 by comparing the current estimate to the prior diagonal for underwriting years <= 2020. The technical provisions note shows RITC impacts (see claims provisions reconciliation) which can distort development patterns; as such the triangle-based PYD may be influenced by RITC and whole-account quota-share movements. The Managing Agent also cites a GBP 14.0m improvement on the 2021 YOA (explicit, net effect on underwriting result) which is a net (after reinsurance) figure; a gross movement note was not separately provided. LOB-specific reserve movements are not explicitly quantified in the report; listed LOB directions are inferred from narrative and segmental claims exposure comments.
